Publish faster, without leaving the page

Compose, preview and ship every page from a single canvas. No build step, no context switching, no waiting on a deploy.

examples.label: Destructive confirmation with the submit button mid-flight
examples.source:
Delete this workspace

Every page, draft and media file in the workspace is removed. This cannot be undone once the job finishes.
